idea-plugin.name: HTBXIII Learning Agent Tools
idea-plugin.description:
Lets an AI learning agent teach inside the editor. Instead of writing code for you, the agent explains the code you already have, right where it is.

  • Highlights code: a line, a block of lines, or an exact column range, in any file of the project.
  • Explains above the code: each highlight gets an explanation box rendered in the editor directly above it.
  • Linked explanation trees: explanations link to deeper explanations and to other ranges of code, so the learner chooses how deep to go. Missing explanations are generated on demand.
  • Step-by-step walkthroughs: plays back the execution of a function line by line, showing variable values, the call stack and program output.

Explanations and walkthroughs are described as JSON, so any agent can drive the plugin. Try it by hand from the Tools menu.

Made for HackTheBurgh XIII (2026), JetBrains "Help the Developer" challenge.
